{Mirror of the Home-Way}

Towns and Villages are flying through the {Mirror's} depths ...
While staring into the mirror you understand that these are {YOUR} lands and those of your allies...
If you wish, you may travel to any unoccupied town in these lands right now.
To give several gold coins to the {Mirror} Keeper is all that's required.

The Keeper demands 1,000 gold before revealing the way. The fee will not be returned if you change your mind in the town selection or if no passage is possible.
Travel to an unoccupied town belonging to you or an ally for 1,000 gold, without spending mana or movement points. The fee is paid before town selection and is not refundable.
